name: vscode-extension-boilerplate
description: VS Code extension for AWS and Kubernetes utilities

commands.title: AWS & Kube Utils: Open Setup Guide

awsKubeUtils.awsCaBundlePath.description: Path to the SSL certificate file for AWS SSO login (--ca-bundle parameter)

awsKubeUtils.statusBarRefreshInterval.description: Interval in milliseconds to refresh the AWS profile status bar (default: 60000ms = 1 minute)

walkthroughs.title: AWS & Kubernetes Setup
walkthroughs.description: Setup guide for AWS CLI and kubectl prerequisites

steps.title: Install AWS CLI
steps.description:
Install the AWS CLI v2 to use AWS features.
[Install AWS CLI](https://aws.amazon.com/cli/)

steps.title: Install kubectl
steps.description:
Install kubectl to use Kubernetes features.
[Install kubectl](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/tools/)

steps.title: Configure Extension Settings
steps.description:
Configure the SSL certificate path for AWS SSO login.
[Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22awsKubeUtils%22%5D)

steps.title: Verify package.json
steps.description: Ensure your workspace has a package.json with a 'name' property at the root.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
